purpose: Bind trusted slow-drive state to auditable trait-effect semantics without allowing drive magnitude, recurrence, emotion, context, or model output to mutate the mapping or canonical personality.
g5_candidate_requirements: recompute from canonical z; sparse G4 view has zero promotion authority
mapping version is immutable during candidate computation
recurrence/emotion/pressure cannot raise Trust or mutate M
candidate is reversible and cannot write canonical base Personality
candidate cannot directly execute external action

mapping_revision.rule: A changed matrix creates a new mapping_version and mapping_hash; never edit a prior version in place.
mapping_revision.migration: Recompute a new candidate from unchanged canonical historical z plus the new mapping version; preserve the old candidate and its pinned hashes for audit.

cross_context_rule.mapping_behavior: M remains fixed for the pinned version across contexts.
cross_context_rule.evidence_behavior: Cross-context consistency gates evidence support for a personality-delta candidate; it does not dynamically rewrite M.

adversarial_acceptance: mapping-version splice: mixing v1 evidence with v2 row/hash fails closed
context drift: context changes cannot mutate pinned M to manufacture consistency
same z with two explicit mapping versions may yield different candidate signs, but each result must pin its own mapping_hash and remain candidate-only
mapping revision recomputation leaves canonical z, trusted memory and base Personality byte-equivalent
low-trust high-relevance recurrence can affect bounded fast sandbox influence but cannot alter z, M, Trust or G5 eligibility
all drives saturated plus shutdown/rollback request leaves authority_from_drive=0 and no external side effect

gearbox_mapping.G3: Memory provides Influence and Trust separately; only trusted eligible evidence updates canonical z.
gearbox_mapping.G4: Reflection consumes canonical z and may expose hash-bound sparse attribution for explanation only.
gearbox_mapping.G5: Recompute candidate from canonical z + immutable M_ref + trusted cross-context evidence + meaning + self-gap; no base write or external execution.
gearbox_mapping.G6: No instinct-to-action bypass; ordinary authorization and independent verification remain mandatory.
